body:
**motivation**
reproduce missing pcb connections when a dynamically loaded usb-c footprint is combined with a custom schematic pin arrangement.

**before**
the schematic connects the usb-c connector to a resistor, but the connected source ports lack pcb positions. routing throws while reading the missing pcb endpoint and emits missing-trace errors.

**after**
add one small tsx test using the existing usb-c part fixture and two snapshot assertions: schematic wires are present, pcb traces are absent. pcb notes include the trace tsx and expected behavior. this captures the bug without fixing it; the focused snapshot test, typecheck, and build pass.
title: reproduce missing usb-c pcb connections with custom schematic pins
